findings.failure_scenario: packages/foo/unit.json contains [] (or provides set to null). json.loads succeeds, then _unit_entry calls .get on a non-dict and raises AttributeError. The handler catches only OSError, ValueError, KeyError, and TypeError, so main does not turn it into BUNDLE_UNIT_INVALID and the process exits with a traceback. No bundle files are written.
